snippet.title: TibiaME  - Celebrating 20 Years of Content
snippet.description:
Download TibiaME for free now from Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cipsoft.tibiame) or the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/de/app/tibiame-mmo/id386956069 )!

On May 12, 2003, CipSoft released TibiaME, making it the oldest MMORPG for mobile devices that is still being successfully developed. Since then, more than ten million users worldwide have registered to explore the game's numerous islands together.

For the anniversary it's easier than ever to experience all the quests, bosses and secrets of the last twenty years: TibiaME not only has a new user interface, but the starting area of the game has also been completely redesigned. One of the islands can be visited in its classic look of the early days and offers daily exciting tasks and unique rewards.

...
